title: EA-OMEGA-BUILD-01: The Ω Build Program — Corpora Seating, Three Site Extensions, and the Continuity Protocol
creator: Sharks, Lee
description: Work-plan deposit governing the build phase that follows the Ω erratum program's five records (#1493–#1497). Four workstreams: EA-CORPORA-01, the seating of verified, parsable, original-language primary texts on alexanarch — Josephus, Catullus, Theocritus, Swete Septuagint, Philo, Plato, Longinus, Hebrew Bible (Westminster Leningrad), Greek New Testament (Nestle 1904), Sappho on a public-domain base with a diplomatic fragment-31 layer, and papyri via the idp.data mirror (Sappho and Oxyrhynchus New Testament papyri both ruled in) — each corpus carrying originals, normalized text, source manifest with license and commit pin, SHA-256 manifest, and its own mint; the Slavonic Josephus resolved by ruling after a documented negative search of open corners to a curated contested-status pericope set with per-passage provenance. Second, revelationfirst.com gains the Upstream Unfoldings: six plates in the site's operable-transform idiom running Sappho into Longinus, Philo, Addition D and Antiquities 11, the inverted Bellum realization, the contested Slavonic carrier, and the tested Revelation 12 — the last doubling as the counter-stack's first transform-view edition. Third, provenanceerasure.org gains the Deep Time wing (the suppression map as PER-of-the-tradition) and the Controller page with the 2026-08-17 closed cycle as first curve point. Fourth, machinemediation.org receives the field's instruments: the EA-RECEPTION-01 reception-edge schema with mandatory counterargument slots, the operator registry seeded by the twelve frozen clauses, and the five-record arc as the discipline's first complete case study. The plan's first section is a continuity protocol binding every session to a state ledger and next-action pointer, with the house gates restated, so that context survives across builds the way the program says provenance should survive across channels. The living document resides at data/worklists/EA-OMEGA-BUILD-01.md; this deposit is its version 1.0 of record.
